clauses.text: A missing or unreadable judgment journal returns unavailable, never an empty list; schema-invalid proofs are returned as rejected with reasons.
Each proof falls into exactly one section in the order waiting_human, blocked, continued_without_human, other; proofs whose placement web_surface is none are other.

Feedback is appended to a separate JSONL file under the personal data directory, is idempotent for the same attempt, status and summary, requires a summary for corrected and reverted, and is read back before success is returned; journal files are never modified.
Listed proofs carry the latest feedback with a verified human_feedback evidence reference, and the full feedback history is returned separately.
Placement web_surface is review exactly when the proof is included in the weekly digest, and none otherwise.
A malformed feedback record fails loudly instead of being skipped.
